config.calibration_note: Each dataset's verdict comes from its own calibration artifact rather than this flag, and is recorded in the manifest; with require_calibration false, a failing dataset still runs the arm and is reported. With mean-centering these settings reach recall@deepest-depth 0.92 on NFCorpus and 0.85 on SciFact; without it the same settings reach 0.68 and the arm is not usable at all.
